interpretation: All rates in this file measure AGREEMENT BETWEEN ECGFounder AND THE DATASET LABELS. They are not label accuracy and not a label-error rate: ECGFounder is an independent model-based reference with its own errors, trained on a different population (HEEDB) with a different label vocabulary (MUSE statements). 'potentially_incorrect' and 'potentially_missing' are model-supported candidates for expert review, not verified errors. Estimating the true label-error rate requires an independent expert re-annotation of a (random) sample.

run.dataset_overlap_with_ecgfounder_training: PTB-XL (Physikalisch-Technische Bundesanstalt, Berlin; Schiller devices, 1989-1996) is not part of ECGFounder's pretraining data (Harvard-Emory ECG Database, MGH + Emory). The official repository uses PTB-XL as an external validation set for the 150-class head (ptbxl_eval.py, csv/ptbxl_label.csv) and the paper uses it for downstream experiments. Released 150-class weights are therefore not expected to have been trained on these labels, but thresholds published by the authors were tuned on PTB-XL and are not reused.
